author: MasterProX
body:
Username  —  Mees2013
Offense  —  Wrongly accusing me, in a needlessly pejorative manner, of disrespecting him.
Evidence  —  https://www.dropbox.com/s/909f6rzkzixgf96/2015-01-09-2.log.txt?dl=0
Once again, I didn't think of taking screenshots until after the desired messages had disappeared amidst the hundreds of others; thus, all I have is the chat log.

Around thirty minutes prior to typing this, I told a player to use the "/report" command instead of declaiming his beliefs on who's hacking in the chat. I think the lines I've singled out should be enough to determine an appropriate punishment.

[12:11:47] [G] Mees2013: hacks
[12:11:52] [G] xxMasterPro*: Mees2013, use "/report"...
[12:12:02] [G] disnowball: Mees2013 we aren't hacking, but you are a big noob
[12:12:13] [G] xLeXz: Indeed disnowball
[12:12:48] [G] Mees2013: xxMasterPro ig dare you have never had a girfriend
[12:12:53] [G] Mees2013: you little gamer nerd
[12:13:00] [G] xxMasterPro*: ...?
[12:13:02] [G] Mees2013: fucking gayboy
[12:13:07] [G] xxMasterPro*: xD
[12:13:18] [G] Mees2013: you think your cool because you are good at MINECARFT
[12:13:22] [G] Mees2013: stfu plz
[12:13:31] [G] xxMasterPro*: Dude, all I said was to use "/report".
[12:13:35] [G] Mees2013: every1 knows that people hack on this server
[12:13:43] [G] xxMasterPro*: So report them...
[12:14:03] [G] Mees2013: xxMasterPro I used report
[12:14:22] [G] xxMasterPro*: Then your job is done, let the staff come and deal with it.
[12:14:29] [G] xxMasterPro*: Don't be like "hacks".
[12:14:35] [G] xLeXz: xxMasterPro
[12:14:37] [G] Mees2013: you said I am a big noob
[12:14:41] [G] Mees2013: wtf
[12:14:43] [G] xLeXz: You should just shut up and stop being a huge noob.
[12:14:43] [G] xxMasterPro*: Wasn't me...
[12:14:44] [G] Mees2013: just no
[12:14:55] [G] xxMasterPro*: I didn't even do anything, lol.
[12:15:08] [G] Mees2013: Wtf I saw it in chat
[12:15:18] [G] Mees2013: dont do like you didnt say anything
[12:15:24] [G] xxMasterPro*: Because I didn't.
[12:15:28] [G] xxMasterPro*: Check your chat logs.
[12:15:33] [G] xxMasterPro*: And be civil.
[12:16:46] [G] Mees2013: on the old lobby I sometimes had like 25 killstreaks I am not a noob.Bye
